Fiji typhoid vaccine line list
This report generates a list of all patients that have had a typhoid vaccination with a status of 'Given' 'Not given' or 'Recorded-in-error'. Each row in the report represents a typhoid vaccination dose and includes information about the patient, vaccine name and vaccine date.
Patients are listed by 'Vaccine date' in chronological order (oldest to newest).
